subject: Invest in Medford Campaign Kickoff
overview: David Zabner, treasurer for the Invest in Medford campaign, spoke in support of school funding initiatives and solicited donations for voter outreach.

items.title: Campaign Kickoff Remarks
items.summary: Treasurer David Zabner advocated for school funding to support teachers and educational resources, warning that insufficient investment leads to service cuts and community decline. He requested donations to reach a $6,000 goal for campaign mailers aimed at reaching voters during the high-turnout election.
